html:
🎃 Halloween Costume Contest Winners Are In!

Halloween at Lady L was one for the books — big thanks to everyone who stopped by in costume, grabbed some goodies, and showed out with serious creativity. You made the shop come alive (and a little spooky 👻).

After plenty of laughs and tough deliberation from the Lady L crew, we’ve got our winners:

🥉 Third Place (shared): Gumby and Weed Leaf — grabbed a $1 eighth for pure Halloween spirit and keeping things green.

🥈 Second Place: Masked Cannabis Axe Wielding — scored a $1 half-ounce for keeping it cleaver.

🥇 First Place: Classic Weed Loving Witch — took home a $1 ounce for going all out as the crowd favorite.

You can check out the top costumes on our Instagram and help us show these legends some love.

Huge thanks again to everyone who joined in, grabbed a treat (or a trick), and made the day a blast. Keep your eyes out for our next in-store event — and maybe start brainstorming your costume ideas for next year… we’ll be ready.

🖤
